learning.description: The Great Indian Desert, an arid region in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent.
learning.fact: Covering over 200,000 sq km, it forms a natural boundary between India and Pakistan.
learning.hint: Located mostly in the largest Indian state by area.

practice.task: Identify the state where the Thar Desert is predominantly located.

quiz.question: Click on the state primarily associated with the Thar Desert.

feedback.correct: Correct! Rajasthan holds the majority of the Thar Desert.
feedback.wrong: It's primarily in Rajasthan. Try clicking the large state in northwestern India.

learning.description: The first civil disobedience movement led by Mahatma Gandhi in India (1917).
learning.fact: It protested the forced cultivation of indigo by British planters.
learning.hint: Located in a state known for its ancient universities like Nalanda.

practice.task: Find the general location of Champaran in India.

quiz.question: Click near Champaran, the site of Gandhi's first Satyagraha.

feedback.correct: Spot on! Champaran is located in Bihar.
feedback.wrong: Champaran is in northern Bihar, near the Nepal border.

learning.description: The primary space agency of the Government of India, formed in 1969.
learning.fact: It manages India's space program, including missions like Chandrayaan and Mangalyaan.
learning.hint: Known as the Silicon Valley of India.

practice.task: Find the city where ISRO is headquartered.

quiz.question: Click on Bengaluru, the headquarters of ISRO.

feedback.correct: Excellent! ISRO is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
feedback.wrong: ISRO's HQ is in Bengaluru in the southern state of Karnataka.

learning.description: The world's largest river island, situated in the Brahmaputra River.
learning.fact: It became the first island to be made a district in India in 2016.
learning.hint: Located in the state famous for Kaziranga National Park.

practice.task: Identify the state that is home to Majuli Island.

quiz.question: Click on the state containing the Majuli river island.

feedback.correct: Correct! Majuli is situated in Assam.
feedback.wrong: Majuli is in Assam, located in Northeast India.

learning.description: The seaside village where Gandhi broke the salt law in 1930.
learning.fact: The 24-day march covered 240 miles from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.
learning.hint: Located on the Arabian Sea coast in a western Indian state.

practice.task: Find the coastal location of Dandi.

quiz.question: Click on Dandi, where the Salt March concluded.

feedback.correct: Great! Dandi is securely located on the coast of Gujarat.
feedback.wrong: Dandi is located near Navsari on the coast of Gujarat.

learning.description: A 13th-century CE Sun Temple built by King Narasimhadeva I.
learning.fact: Designed in the shape of a colossal chariot, it is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
learning.hint: Located on the coastline of a state prone to cyclones.

practice.task: Find the state where the Konark Sun Temple stands.

quiz.question: Click on the state home to the Konark Sun Temple.

feedback.correct: Spot on! The Sun Temple is in Odisha.
feedback.wrong: It is located in Odisha (formerly Orissa) on the eastern coast.

learning.fact: It's the largest wintering ground for migratory birds on the Indian sub-continent.
learning.hint: It lies south of the Mahanadi Delta.

practice.task: Find the location of Lake Chilika on the map.

feedback.correct: Perfect! Chilika Lake is on the east coast, in Odisha.
feedback.wrong: Chilika is located on the eastern coastline in the state of Odisha.

learning.description: A public garden in Amritsar where a peaceful crowd was massacred by British troops in 1919.
learning.fact: The incident deeply shocked the nation and was a turning point in the independence movement.
learning.hint: Located near the Golden Temple in a northwestern state.

practice.task: Locate the city where the Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred.

quiz.question: Click on Amritsar, the site of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

feedback.correct: Correct! Jallianwala Bagh is in Amritsar, Punjab.
feedback.wrong: Amritsar is located in northern Punjab, near the Pakistani border.

learning.description: One of the largest concrete gravity dams, built on the Narmada river.
learning.fact: It provides water and electricity to four Indian states.
learning.hint: Located in the state closely associated with the Narmada Bachao Andolan.

practice.task: Identify the state where the Sardar Sarovar Dam is primarily located.

quiz.question: Click on the state housing the Sardar Sarovar Dam.

feedback.correct: Well done! The dam is in Gujarat.
feedback.wrong: The Sardar Sarovar Dam is located in Gujarat, along the Narmada River.

learning.description: A decisive victory of the British East India Company over the Nawab of Bengal (1757).
learning.fact: It marked the beginning of consolidated British rule in India.
learning.hint: Fought in Palashi, located in an eastern state named after its historical region.

practice.task: Identify the modern state where the Battle of Plassey took place.

quiz.question: Click on the state where Palashi (Plassey) is located.

feedback.correct: Correct! Palashi is in modern-day West Bengal.
feedback.wrong: The battle took place in West Bengal, on the banks of the Hooghly River.
